newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan Central Bank raises reserve requirement.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan Central Bank raises reserve requirement.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank on Monday said it was raising the reserve requirement for commercial banks to 17 percent from 15 percent.

The additional two percentage point deposit held at the Central Bank would bear interest, the bank said in a statement. The first 15 percentage points of the reserve requirement is not interest bearing.
The interest rate would be calculated on the basis of the average interest rate of commercial banks' saving accounts and time deposits, the Central Bank said.
The statement did not say when the measure, which had been widely expected on local money markets, would go into effect.
It was the second increase in the reserve requirement in the last three weeks as the Central Bank tries to soak up excess liquidity to ease inflationary and currency pressures.
The reserve requirement was raised to 15 percent from 10 percent on July 10.
